s: A company has 350 AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. A central backup team works from a dedicated backup-admin account and must not use the management account. The team must enforce daily backups of every resource tagged backup=daily in all member accounts. Each backup must be copied to a vault in a separate central vault account. Member-account administrators must not be able to change the backup plans. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Use CloudFormation StackSets from the backup-admin account to deploy an AWS Backup plan and vault into every account, with a copy rule to the central vault account.
Create an AWS Config rule that detects tagged resources that have no recovery point, and invoke an AWS Lambda function that starts on-demand backups and copies them to the central vault account.

From the management account, enable AWS Backup cross-account management and backup policies, register the backup-admin account as a delegated administrator for AWS Backup, and create an Organizations resource-based delegation policy that lets it manage backup policies. From the backup-admin account, create an AWS Backup policy that targets the organization root with a tag-based selection and a cross-account copy action to the central vault, whose access policy allows the organization.
From the management account, create an AWS Backup policy for the organization root. Grant the backup team an IAM role in the management account to maintain the policy.

w.y: A delegated administrator (registered and granted a resource-based delegation policy in Organizations) can manage organization backup policies from outside the management account. Plans created through policies are immutable in member accounts, and the policy's copy action handles cross-account copies. 'LEAST operational overhead' and 'not the management account' together point to this answer.

o.A: Plans deployed by StackSets are local resources that member administrators can edit or delete, and the stacks need ongoing upkeep.
o.B: Custom detect-and-backup Lambda functions are high-overhead and do not stop members from changing anything.
o.C: Correct: a delegated administrator plus an organization backup policy enforces the plan centrally with built-in cross-account copy.
o.D: This works, but it puts the backup team in the management account, which the requirement forbids.

d: LEAST operational overhead; not the management account
